Pakistan Conducts Strikes in Afghanistan; Civilian and Militant Deaths Reported

Pakistan has conducted airstrikes and a ground operation along its border with Afghanistan, stating that 29 militants were killed. However, Afghan officials and the Taliban reported that dozens of civilians, including children and women, also died in the strikes. The Pakistani action was described as retaliatory following multiple militant attacks within Pakistan.
